subject: Workplace Skills
title: Setting Boundaries at Work
description: A micro-lesson that makes Setting Boundaries at Work usable.

hook.text: She answered Slack messages at 11 PM for months. When she stopped, colleagues accused her of checking out.

buildup.text: Boundaries you don't set become expectations others enforce. Start as you mean to continue.

discovery.text: A boundary is a behavior you commit to, not a rule you impose on others. 'I log off at 6' is yours to set.

twist.text: People who set boundaries consistently are respected more than those who bend to every request.

climax.text: State boundaries early and clearly: 'I protect my mornings for deep work. I'm available after 10.'

punchline.text: Set boundaries early. Consistency earns respect.

quiz.question: What happens when you don't set work boundaries early?
options: Your unset boundaries become expectations others enforce
